<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>EX-10.20</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.20 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>OMNIBUS AMENDMENT TO </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>THE ASHTEAD GROUP LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN 2021 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This omnibus amendment (this &#8220;<U>Amendment</U>&#8221;) by Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the
&#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221;), effective as of the effectiveness of the Company&#8217;s Form 10 registration statement (the &#8220;<U>Effective Time</U>&#8221;), amends the Ashtead Group Long-Term Incentive Plan 2021 (the &#8220;<U>Plan</U>&#8221;).
Capitalized terms that are not defined in this Amendment shall have the meanings ascribed thereto in the Plan, except as otherwise provided herein. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>,<B> </B>as of the Effective Time, the Company will assume the Plan and all rights and obligations under the Plan; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>,<B> </B>Section&nbsp;12.1 of the Plan provides that the Compensation Committee of the Board of the Directors of the Company
(&#8220;<U>Committee</U>&#8221;) may amend the Plan from time to time; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>WHEREAS</B>, the Committee has determined it to be in its
best interests to amend the Plan as set forth herein. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>NOW, THEREFORE</B>, <B>BE IT RESOLVED THAT</B>, the Plan shall be amended as
follows, effective as of the Effective Time: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. The name of the Plan shall be amended its entirety as follows: &#8220;Sunbelt Rentals
Holdings, Inc. Long-Term Incentive Plan 2021&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. The definition of &#8220;<B>Company</B>&#8221; in the Plan shall be amended and
restated in its entirety as follows: &#8220;<B>Company</B>&#8221;<I> </I>means Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its successors by operation of law.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. The definition of &#8220;<B>London Stock Exchange</B>&#8221; in the Plan shall be amended and restated in its entirety as follows:
&#8220;<B>Applicable Exchange</B>&#8221; means the New York Stock Exchange, the London Stock Exchange or any other national stock exchange or quotation system on which the Shares may be listed or quoted.&#8221; References to &#8220;London Stock
Exchange&#8221; shall be replaced by references to &#8220;Applicable Exchange&#8221;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. The definition of &#8220;<B>Market
Value</B>&#8221; in the Plan shall be amended and restated in its entirety as follows: &#8220;<B>Market Value</B>&#8221; means, in relation to a Share on any date: (i)&nbsp;the closing per Share sales price as reported by the New York Stock Exchange
(or any other national stock exchange or quotation system on which the Shares may be listed or quoted) for such date or if there were no sales on such date, on the closest preceding date on which there were sales of Shares or (ii)&nbsp;if the
Committee so determines, such closing per Share sales price for any other trading date (or the average of such closing per Share sales price for any trading dates) occurring before the relevant date, as the Committee may determine, provided that
such trading dates do not fall within any period when Dealing Restrictions apply to the Participant in respect of the Award or the Shares subject to the Award (and, in the case of a US Participant, such basis is in accordance with US Treasury
Regulation <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">1.409A-1(b)(5)(iv)(A)).&#8221;</FONT> </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. The definition of &#8220;<B>Plan</B>&#8221; in the Plan shall be amended and restated in
its entirety as follows: &#8220;<B>Plan</B>&#8221;<I> </I>means the plan constituted by these rules known as the &#8220;Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. Long-Term Incentive Plan 2021&#8221;, as amended from time to time.&#8221; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. References to &#8220;shareholder&#8221; or &#8220;shareholders&#8221; in the Plan shall mean &#8220;stockholder&#8221; or
&#8220;stockholders&#8221;, respectively, of Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc.. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. References to the name and address on the first page of
the Plan shall instead refer to Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc., 1799 Innovation Pt, Fort Mill, South Carolina 29715. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8. To the extent
that Shares are required to, or may, be issued pursuant to an Award, shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock, par value $0.01 per share, will be issued upon the exercise or settlement (as applicable) of any such Award previously granted under the
Plan, including, for the avoidance of doubt, an Award that was granted and outstanding prior to the Effective Time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9. Until surrendered
and exchanged, each Award Certificate delivered to a Participant pursuant to a Plan and evidencing outstanding Shares immediately prior to the Effective Time shall, for all purposes of the Plan and the Shares, continue to evidence the identical
amount and number of outstanding Shares at and after the Effective Time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">10. Any Award previously granted under the Plan and subject to a
Holding Period (including, for the avoidance of doubt, a Holding Period structured pursuant to rule 1.13 (<I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Post-tax</FONT> holding of Shares</I>) for a Conditional Award granted to a US Participant) shall no longer
be subject to such Holding Period. References to &#8220;Holding Period&#8221; shall be deleted in their entirety and any corresponding provisions that contain a reference to &#8220;Holding Period&#8221; shall otherwise be interpreted and
administered accordingly as if originally drafted without such reference. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">11. Except as modified by this Amendment, all of the terms and
conditions of the Plan shall remain valid and in full force and effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">***** </P>
</DIV></Center>
